entities.summary: Gabriel Alomar i Villalonga was a Spanish poet, essayist, educator and diplomat. He was closely related to the Catalan art movement Modernisme. He was an active leftist libertarian, chiefly in Barcelona and the other Catalan-speaking regions, from the first years of the 20th century until his death from pneumonia in exile.
